operator_io_quirks: Mixed quoting in DDL: country/match_season/player use double quotes, team uses backticks; identifiers must be re-quoted with " in generated SQL.
Table name `team` is a SQL keyword-ish; always double-quote it.
match_season PK is `Season` REAL (float PK) — PK uniqueness on floats; sample_fresh_primary_keys must dedupe on float tuples.
match_season.Season is REAL but values are whole years (1996.0..); Number fuzzer with scale from REAL (no args) -> scale 0, int-ish floats.
player.Years_Played / Total_WL / Singles_WL / Doubles_WL are TEXT storing 'W-L' and 'N (years)' patterns with en-dash U+2013, not ASCII '-'.
match_season.Player values contain 'Category:Articles with hCards' junk suffix — long strings, distinct=16.
All columns notnull=0, no CHECK, no UNIQUE beyond PKs; sqlite will accept NULLs and type-mismatched values.
FKs: match_season.Country->country.Country_id, match_season.Team->team.Team_id, player.Team->team.Team_id; all parents exist and are unique PKs.
Tiny tables (6/10/16 rows) — choose_table_sizes will produce sizes far larger than originals; FK draws with replacement from small parent sets.
No self-FK, no composite PK, no dangling FK, no views/triggers/indexes beyond PKs.
Storage classes match declared types everywhere (integer/real/text); no contradictions.
country.Official_native_language has spaces and parentheses inside values (e.g. 'Persian ( Arabic script )').
operator_ts_expectations: Number fuzzer on Country_id/Team_id/Player_ID (INT, no args): scale 0, range [-1,1] then perturb +-1/+-2 -> tiny ints, mostly 0/1/2; PK dedupe will collapse many rows.
Number fuzzer on Season (REAL): scale 0, range [-1,1] floats; PK dedupe on floats leaves few distinct rows -> match_season likely near-empty after sample_fresh_primary_keys.
Number fuzzer on Draft_Pick_Number (INT): same tiny range, implausible vs real 2..87 -> FN on range predicates.
String fuzzer on Player/Name/College/Position: random charset strings + contaminate, plus 5 sampled originals; 'Category:Articles...' junk may be resampled.
String fuzzer on Years_Played/Total_WL/etc: length range from originals (short), int-like detection fails on 'W-L' so no +-1 variants; en-dash preserved only via element reuse.
FK columns (Country, Team) draw from parent's FINAL filtered values with replacement; if parent PK dedupe leaves 1-2 rows, FK diversity collapses -> missing ties/duplicates (FP source).
No NOT NULL/CHECK enforcement: NULLs and type-mismatched values inserted freely; only PK/UNIQUE constraint failures are skipped at insert.
Tiny originals (6/10/16) mean literal pool from train SQL dominates element lists; p=0.2 fresh draws still inject random strings.
Date/Time/Bool fuzzers unused (no such declared types).
Position has only 3 distinct values (Midfielder/Defender/Forward); String fuzzer will not preserve this enum -> FN on Position='Forward' style filters.
Draft_Class values like '1996 MLS College Draft' are long; String length range from originals is wide, fresh strings rarely match.
